description: Land Accounts (LEAC) PHARE Data is a dataset listed in EEA SDI - geospatial data catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sdi.eea.europa.eu. Land Cover Accounts are part of the Land and Ecosystem Accounting project which deal with data on changes in land cover and land use and seek to trace the wider environmental, social and economic implications of these transformations. Coverage: Europe. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eea-sdi.
